from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u001/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
script='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # Only complete rectangular outlines with a uniform background interior.
            if not all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                continue
            if any(grid[y][x] != bg for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''

def blank(h,w,bg): return [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
def frame(g,r0,c0,r1,c1,color):
    for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r0][c]=g[r1][c]=color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1): g[r][c0]=g[r][c1]=color

def set_interior(g,r0,c0,r1,c1,color):
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1): g[r][c]=color
# Demo 1: ring with single hole plus hollow 6x6 frame
D1=blank(16,27,5); frame(D1,0,19,2,21,6); frame(D1,6,11,11,16,3)
E1=[row[:] for row in D1]; set_interior(E1,0,19,2,21,7); set_interior(E1,6,11,11,16,2)
assert mod.transform(D1)==E1

E2=[row[:] for row in D2]
